favorites.empty: You don't have any favourite farmers yet.
favorites.loginText: You need to log in to save favourites.
favorites.addedText: You'll be notified about restocks and new products.

auth.emailTakenText: An account with this email already exists. Log in or, if you haven't confirmed your registration yet, check your inbox.
auth.createdText: Check your email to confirm your registration.
auth.farmerNext: After confirming your email, you'll be taken to complete your farm profile with company details and certificates.
auth.acceptTerms: By creating an account, you accept the <terms>Terms and Conditions</terms> and confirm you have read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
auth.googleFarmer: The Google account will be linked to the farmer profile selected above.
auth.googleClient: The Google account will be linked to the customer profile selected above.
auth.noAccountText: We couldn't find an account linked to this Google account. To create one, choose your profile type and use "Sign up with Google".

profile.title: My profile
profile.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB. It only appears on your reviews if you allow it for each one.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sharedPassword: Your farmer account and your customer account share the same email and password. Changing the password here changes access to both profiles.
settings.logoutText: Log out of your account on this device.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.text: Deletes your personal data and closes the account, in both profiles (customer and farmer). You can create a new account with the same email, but you will have to fill everything in again.
delete.blockedText: Before deleting your account, finish what is pending:
delete.clientOrders_one: {{count}} of your orders or bookings is not finished
delete.clientOrders_other: {{count}} of your orders or bookings are not finished
delete.farmerOrders_one: {{count}} customer order or booking still to deliver
delete.farmerOrders_other: {{count}} customer orders or bookings still to deliver
delete.farmerSubscriptions_one: {{count}} customer with an active subscription (cancel it in Subscriptions)
delete.farmerSubscriptions_other: {{count}} customers with an active subscription (cancel them in Subscriptions)
delete.whatDeleted: We delete your name, photo, favourites and notifications; your farm, products, experiences, accommodation and subscriptions are no longer shown.
delete.whatKept: Orders and invoicing are kept for 10 years, as required by law, without being linked to your name.
delete.whatReviews: The reviews you wrote remain, anonymised.
delete.whatEmail: You can create a new account with the same email, starting from scratch.
delete.typeEmail: To confirm, type the account email ({{email}})
delete.doneText: Your personal data has been deleted. Thank you for using ValorRural.

verify.verifiedText: You can now buy as a customer.
verify.title: Verify your customer profile
verify.text: To buy as a customer you need to confirm your email with the 6-digit code we send you.

coins.intro: Earn 1 coin for every euro you spend. Coins have no cash value: they are exchanged for gifts offered by the farmers.
coins.rewardsSoon: Soon you'll be able to exchange them for gifts at participating farms.
coins.howOrders: {{n}} coin for every euro spent on delivered orders (excluding the delivery fee).
coins.howBookings: +{{n}} coins for every completed experience or stay.
coins.howReviews: {{n}} coins for reviewing a delivered order, whatever the rating.
coins.howTiming: Coins become available {{days}} days after delivery and expire {{months}} months later.
coins.historyEmpty: No activity yet. Coins appear here once an order is delivered.
coins.legal: Coins are personal and non-transferable, have no cash value, cannot be exchanged for euros and do not reduce prices. The euro value is only indicative, to compare gifts.
coins.loadFailed: Couldn't load your coins. Please try again.
coins.reviewNote: You get {{n}} coins for reviewing, whatever the rating.
